name: Time-client quality rejection interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
summary: Identifies the condition in which a device rejects a timing reference of unacceptable quality.
description: Identifies the condition in which a device rejects a timing reference of unacceptable quality. A station time system provides a shared time reference for protection records, measurements and automation. Different devices can use different timing protocols, so the time source, distribution path and quality information must remain identifiable.

In a substation, a station clock can provide precision timing to process equipment and another timing interface to event recorders. The alarm system should distinguish loss of a distribution path from loss of the external time source. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Received time-quality information” at the input and “Time-reference rejection” at the output. Rejection criteria are device-specific.
